ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-09-2014 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Harry M. Dorfman, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, Proceedings reported by: Miles Lendway, CSR#13684.
Petitioner Ivana Veronica Solorzano present in court.
Petitioner sworn and examined.
Proof of Publication on file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and the petition should be granted. Court amended the Petition in Open court to reflect the following changes: Ivana - First Name, Veronica - Middle Name, Solorzano Flores - Last Name.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name to Ivana - First Name
Veronica - Middle Name
Solorzano Flores - Last Name
Decree Changing Name signed in open court.
